description: Layout reads and scrolling (CSSOM View): getBoundingClientRect, offset/client/scroll metrics of a fractional box pixel-snapped as Chromium snaps them, read by an effect after the DOM update; scrollTop writes, scrollBy and scrollTo on a scroll container read back at once; scrollIntoView with start, nearest, center and end alignment; one scroll event per moved scroller in the rendering step after the action (none when nothing moved), also for wheel scrolling
